title: EvoHakiki
problem: Persistent agents need a governable way to propose change without also controlling the evidence, adjudication, and authority used to approve it.
system: An auditable control plane for evidence-governed agent evolution, historically developed as Reflective Agent through v0.10.
outcome: Phase I defines an architecture-and-methods contribution; Phase II empirical evaluation remains future work.

title: Production agentic AI and evaluation systems
problem: Production workflows need agent behavior that is testable, observable, and subject to human review.
system: Tool-use orchestration, evaluation pipelines, golden examples, and human-in-the-loop automation for real-estate workflows.
outcome: Engineering and evaluation work supporting production-scale real-estate workflows.

title: NiaFaker
problem: Software teams working in African markets often lack realistic, locally formatted test data.
system: An open-source Python package generating localized names, phone numbers, mobile-money data, and national identifiers for ten African economies.
outcome: Publicly available source and package releases support reproducible use and review.

title: IBM Cognos Analytics and AI customer-service proposal for MultiChoice Tanzania
problem: MultiChoice Tanzania was exploring ways to improve call-center efficiency and make better use of its sales and marketing data.
role: Founding member · IBM partnership lead · Solution co-developer and presenter, DEFIGO Group Limited
system: A two-part proposal: a CRM-integrated AI customer-service assistant with agent search, conversational AI, and speech-to-text; and IBM Cognos Analytics dashboards with mapping, promotion analysis, natural-language exploration, and forecasting.
outcome: Presented the analytical solution to MultiChoice Tanzania leaders on 27 April 2022; positive feedback led to a requested follow-up with Operations, Marketing, and Customer Value Management. DEFIGO received IBM Business Partner approval later in 2022 following outreach led by Owden. The engagement remained at proposal stage.
cvSummary: Founding member and IBM partnership lead. Co-developed a CRM-integrated AI customer-service and IBM Cognos Analytics proposal for MultiChoice Tanzania; presented 27 April 2022, prompting a requested cross-department follow-up.

title: EveryListing.com property-data migration
problem: A real-estate platform required a high-volume migration into a relational data system.
system: A PostgreSQL migration pipeline for a large property dataset.
outcome: Completed in February 2022 and received a five-star client review.

title: Climate-smart agriculture platform
problem: Agricultural programs needed better field data, plot mapping, and delivery support for climate-smart practices.
system: A digital platform supporting the IMAP4CSA program and its farmer-facing operations.
outcome: Kilimo Trust reports program results of 10,119 mapped plots containing 7,552 farmer profiles, 22,952 messages or digital-information items sent to 11,964 farmers, and 11,565 farmers trained.

title: BRELA Online Registration System
problem: Business-registration services in Tanzania needed an online channel for institutional and public use.
system: Work on BRELA’s online registration system through an earlier technology venture.
outcome: Presented the system at the 2015 TNBC meeting at which it launched; linked BRELA materials provide institutional context.

title: Secure payment systems
problem: Digital services required payment integrations designed around established security and compliance controls.
system: Payment gateway integrations involving CyberSource, DPO, and PesaPal.
outcome: Delivered payment integrations across institutional digital services.

title: ShuleSoft
problem: Schools needed integrated administration, finance, academic, and communication workflows.
system: A school-management platform for Tanzanian institutions.
outcome: The platform remains active and continues serving Tanzanian education institutions.

title: Healthcare technology
problem: Healthcare platforms need ongoing technical stewardship after launch.
role: Co-founder and board advisor, EMET Healthcare
system: Technology guidance and platform development for healthcare access initiatives.
outcome: Continues as board-level advisory work on platform direction and healthcare access.
